intro: Uganda's distance runners and its football and netball teams are national heroes.

chapters.title: Running
text: John Akii-Bua won the 400 m hurdles at the 1972 Olympics. Joshua Cheptegei won 5,000 m gold in 2021 and 10,000 m gold in 2024 and holds world records. Peruth Chemutai won steeplechase gold in 2021.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: The Cranes play football, and the She Cranes netball team has played at World Cups.

keyTerms.meaning: A race over barriers and water jumps.
